steps.what: Confirm the patients identity and the source of the height or weight reading.
Enter the height or weight value in the correct patient record.
Check patient, units and observation time and save the measurement record.

tasks.design: Test native measurement-device import or encounter-linked entry in the {OTHER} clinical record system. Use a supported scale or measuring-device feed only after patient identification, with the assistant checking the exact value and unit before saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Displayed device readings may be retyped into a separate chart.
tasks.enabler_now: Supported native device interfaces can prefill values without language interpretation.
tasks.still_hard: Wrong patient association, unit errors and unreliable readings still require checking.
tasks.human_edge: Notice when a reading does not plausibly represent the person measured.
tasks.altitude: Less numerical transcription; measurement accountability and clinical decision rights stay unchanged.

reach.task: Prepare a complete height-or-weight observation for review.
reach.learn: Device identification, units and correction controls.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: supported measurement-device import can reduce numerical transcription while requiring patient and unit verification.

assumptions: Boundary starts with an obtained height or weight reading and ends at chart entry. Physical measuring, patient movement and nurse interpretation are outside and unchanged.

Device produces device_id, measurement_type, value, unit and observed_time; assistant confirms patient_id and encounter_id before association. Unsupported devices or missing identity retain manual reading and entry; no image extraction or inferred value.

Native import is tested before custom code. Central estimate assumes compatible equipment; access, privacy review and applicable national consultation are included. Original readings and corrections remain auditable.
unknowns: Compatible devices and current entry burden.
research_questions: Can native import preserve units and prevent association with the wrong encounter?

already_counted.description: Review imported measurement against the displayed source.

incremental.description: Report device mapping errors and retry failed imports.
Maintain approved device mappings and access.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=75 gross=25 net=24 after 1 upkeep. Low: unsupported devices or import already used; high: repeated numerical entry removed. Patient identification and final unit checks retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Give visitors or callers permitted directions, hours and patient information.

steps.what: Clarify visitors or callers requests and verify identity where patient information is requested.
Find current directions, visiting hours or the permitted patient-status information.
Check disclosure permission and provide the information or refer the caller to nursing staff.

tasks.design: Test native visitor-information cards in {DOCS} and restricted patient-status views in the {OTHER} clinical record system. Show current sources without generating a clinical update; the assistant verifies permission before giving any patient information and refers requests beyond their authority.
tasks.previous_blocker: General visitor guidance and restricted patient information are stored separately.
tasks.enabler_now: Configured source links can reduce lookup while preserving existing access boundaries.
tasks.still_hard: Caller identity, consent limits and anxious family conversations.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize uncertainty about disclosure and offer an appropriate human referral.

ambition.what: Help first-time visitors understand ward access and visiting arrangements in plain language.

tasks.altitude: Less guidance searching; patient-information disclosure authority stays unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: current-source links can shorten visitor-information lookup while identity and disclosure decisions remain human.

assumptions: Boundary is answering or referring a request, not creating a clinical status assessment. General directions need no patient disclosure, while status requests follow existing authority and consent rules.

Ward administrator supplies location_id, directions, visiting_hours and effective_date; authorized clinical staff supply permitted_status_fields and source_version; record owner supplies consent and disclosure permissions. Missing or unclear permissions cause referral without patient disclosure.

Native configuration first. The s3 check binds permitted information v1, source versions, verified recipient and permission snapshot; changed facts or recipient require another check. Privacy and access review are included.
unknowns: Disclosure roles, caller verification process and current visitor guidance.
research_questions: Can staff find public information quickly without exposing restricted patient fields?

already_counted.description: Check disclosure permission and communicate the response.

incremental.description: Report outdated visitor guidance or access-view errors.

approvals.approved_version: permitted information v1 with source versions, verified recipient and disclosure-permission snapshot; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=87.5 gross=12.5 net=11.5 after 1 upkeep. Low: existing guidance already easy to find; high: fragmented public and restricted sources. Identity, permission checks and conversation are unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Explain authorized medical instructions within delegated care responsibilities.

steps.what: Retrieve the current medical instructions and the approved patient explanation materials.
Clarify unfamiliar or conflicting instructions with the responsible nurse.
Explain medical instructions to patients or authorized family members and check understanding.

tasks.design: Test native links from current instructions in the {OTHER} clinical record system to approved plain-language materials in {DOCS}. The assistant clarifies uncertainty with the nurse and explains only within their delegation, retaining the full conversation and understanding check.
tasks.previous_blocker: The authorized instruction and its approved explanation may be stored in separate places.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-linked approved materials can reduce searching without generating new medical advice.
tasks.still_hard: Complex instructions, language barriers and apparent misunderstanding need qualified human help.
tasks.human_edge: Notice a patient repeating words without understanding and seek further nursing support.

ambition.what: Give patients a clear route to ask unresolved questions after an instruction explanation.

tasks.altitude: Less source searching; no prescribing, interpretation or clinical decision authority is gained.

reach.task: Reinforce an already approved care instruction.
reach.learn: Delegation boundaries and checking understanding without changing the instruction.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: links to approved explanation materials can reduce retrieval while retaining human instruction explanation and clinical clarification.

assumptions: Boundary is reinforcement of current authorized instructions within the assistants permitted duties, not diagnosis, prescribing or independent instruction changes. Clinical questions beyond delegation return to the nurse.

Authorized clinical staff supply patient_id, instruction_id, version, effective_time and exact instruction; clinical education owner supplies approved_material_id, language and linked_instruction_type. Missing, outdated or conflicting material requires manual nurse clarification, not generated simplification.

Native record links first. Permission to involve family is checked under existing care practice; the design adds no new automated disclosure. No model inference or unreviewed medical rewrite is proposed.
unknowns: Delegated explanation duties, approved materials and language coverage.
research_questions: Do source-linked approved materials reduce searching while preserving the exact instruction and escalation of questions?

incremental.description: Report broken or outdated instruction-material links.
Maintain clinically approved materials and source links.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=90 gross=10 net=9 after 1 upkeep. Low: approved materials already beside the instruction; high: separate retrieval removed. Nursing clarification and patient conversation retain all their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce source hunting and numerical transcription while keeping patient identification, permitted communication and care explanations human.
role.ambitious_version: A nursing assistant who explains clearly and records accurately without extending beyond delegated clinical responsibilities.
